title: Trump uses Thanksgiving message to lash out at political foes, immigrants, federal government
html:
US President Donald Trump pardoning Freedom - the 2026 National Thanksgiving Turkey - during a White House ceremony on Nov 24.

PHOTO: BLOOMBERG

AI generated

WASHINGTON - As American families gathered to celebrate one of the biggest holidays of the year, US President Donald Trump on Nov 26 used the occasion of Thanksgiving to attack liberals, immigrants and a federal agency.

In a message on his Truth Social platform, Trump offered holiday greetings to people he accused of fraud, error or criminality.

“I would like to wish a very Happy Thanksgiving to all of those people that have worked so hard to bring our Country to the Radical Far Left,” Trump said, in the 461-word post.

The message was issued while the Republican president spent the family-oriented holiday at his Trump International Golf Club in West Palm Beach, Florida. He was expected to call US service members later on Nov 26 from his Mar-a-Lago estate.

In the holiday greeting, Trump accused his own government of falsifying US economic data.

He warned of efforts by unnamed people to implement Muslim religious law and forcibly redistribute private property.

He also described large numbers of US immigrants and people of Somali descent as jobless or criminal.

Trump offered no evidence for any of the claims, some of which repeated longtime talking points.

The US Commerce Department’s Bureau of Economic Analysis did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

The US president also defended his White House renovation projects, saying reporters and citizens had misunderstood them.

Trump’s Republican Party suffered heavy losses in the Nov 3 midterm elections and will cede control of both chambers of Congress in January. REUTERS
summary: Trump uses Thanksgiving message to attack immigrants, liberals and US government in Truth Social post. Read more at straitstimes.com.
